# KB-AUTH-001

- 엔진(engine): `any`
- 단계(stage): `fetch`
- 심각도(severity): **FAIL**
- 패턴 검증(pattern_verified): **예** — 업스트림 소스 문자열에서 도출
- 패턴 출처(pattern_source): asf_search/ASFSession.py ('Invalid/Expired token passed', 'Failed to log in with provided credentials. Original Exception: ...'); asf_search/download/download.py (ASFAuthenticationError(f'HTTP {status}: {text}')); hyp3_sdk/util.py ('Was not able to authenticate with username and password provided', 'Was not able to authenticate with .netrc file and no credentials provided'); requests/models.py ('{status} Client Error: {reason} for url: ...'); isce2 DemStitcher.py ('Please create a .netrc file in your home directory containing ...')

## 패턴 (regex)

```text
HTTP 40[13]\b|40[13] Client Error|Invalid/Expired token passed|Failed to log in with provided credentials|Was not able to authenticate with (?:username and password provided|\.netrc file and no credentials provided)|Please create a \.netrc file in your home directory|ASFAuthenticationError
```

## 원인 (Cause)

NASA Earthdata Login 인증에 실패했습니다(HTTP 401/403). EARTHDATA_TOKEN 또는 ~/.netrc 의 자격 증명이 없거나 만료되었거나 틀렸고, 계정이 ASF 데이터 접근(EULA)을 승인하지 않았을 수도 있습니다.

_EN_: NASA Earthdata Login authentication failed (HTTP 401/403). The credentials in EARTHDATA_TOKEN or ~/.netrc are missing, expired or wrong, or the account has not approved ASF data access (EULA).

## 조치 (Fix)

https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov 에서 로그인 상태와 토큰 유효기간을 확인하고, EARTHDATA_TOKEN 환경변수 또는 ~/.netrc(machine urs.earthdata.nasa.gov, login/password, 권한 600)를 다시 설정하세요. 'wintersar check-install'이 자격 증명 유무를 점검합니다.

_EN_: Check the account and token expiry at https://urs.earthdata.nasa.gov and reset EARTHDATA_TOKEN or ~/.netrc (machine urs.earthdata.nasa.gov, login/password, mode 600). 'wintersar check-install' verifies that credentials are present.

## 자동 재시도 제안 (retry_hint)

```yaml
stage: fetch
action: manual
params: {}
note: Fix credentials, then rerun the stage.
```
